sources.notes: Actual concept inspected: retain many thin unequal laminae, coherent shallow open fold and rough crosscut broken surfaces. Simplify microtexture, avoid polished slab and photoreal harsh cracks. Original closed full-volume specimen mesh with integrated lateral ribs; lamination not separate stacked slabs, coplanar skins, or disconnected regular belts. Use around32 unequal layer units whose widths/rib offsets vary gently across perimeter. Side silhouette and clay must retain lamination relief. Australian Museum DR.19296 remains text-only because image requests403 and browser timeout; authorised transparent substitution before freeze uses actual USGS-hosted James St.John Soudan photo.
